#7. ChEBI / PubChem / HMDB 轉 KEGG
#8. KEGG ID 加回 annotation table
#9. 用 Compound 對回 measurement
#10. 做 fold change、heatmap、condition-specific metabolite、KEGG pathway input

#coding Step
#29 ChEBI → KEGG
#30 PubChem → KEGG
#31 HMDB → KEGG：匯出 HMDB list 給 MetaboAnalyst
#32 讀回 MetaboAnalyst 的 HMDB-to-KEGG 結果
#33 合併 ChEBI / PubChem / HMDB 三條 KEGG mapping


```{r}
#----29. define KEGG REST conversion function----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 建立一個通用 function，用來把 ChEBI 或 PubChem ID 轉成 KEGG Compound ID。
# 2. 這個 function 會呼叫 KEGG REST API。
# 3. 每次 request 之間停 0.4 秒，避免打太快被擋。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# convert_kegg_id：
#   一個後面會重複使用的 function。
#   它本身還不是資料表。

convert_kegg_id <- function(query_vec, query_col_name, sleep_sec = 0.4) {
  
  query_vec <- unique(na.omit(as.character(query_vec)))
  
  result_list <- vector("list", length(query_vec))
  
  for (i in seq_along(query_vec)) {
    
    query_i <- query_vec[i]
    
    message("KEGG conversion: ", i, " / ", length(query_vec), " ; ", query_i)
    
    result_list[[i]] <- tryCatch({
      
      url <- paste0(
        "https://rest.kegg.jp/conv/compound/",
        query_i
      )
      
      res <- readLines(url, warn = FALSE)
      
      if (length(res) == 0) {
        
        tibble(
          Query_ID = query_i,
          KEGG_ID = NA_character_
        )
        
      } else {
        
        tibble(raw = res) %>%
          separate(raw, into = c("Source_ID", "KEGG_raw"), sep = "\t") %>%
          mutate(
            Query_ID = query_i,
            KEGG_ID = str_replace(KEGG_raw, "^cpd:", "")
          ) %>%
          select(Query_ID, KEGG_ID)
      }
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      
      tibble(
        Query_ID = query_i,
        KEGG_ID = NA_character_
      )
    })
    
    Sys.sleep(sleep_sec)
  }
  
  bind_rows(result_list) %>%
    rename(!!query_col_name := Query_ID) %>%
    distinct()
}
```

```{r}
#----33. import HMDB-to-KEGG conversion result from MetaboAnalyst----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 讀回你剛剛從 MetaboAnalyst 下載的 HMDB -> KEGG conversion 結果。
# 2. 自動找欄位名稱中含有 HMDB 和 KEGG 的欄位。
# 3. 整理成乾淨的 HMDB_ID / KEGG_ID 對照表。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# hmdb_to_kegg_15ppm_top10：
#   一張 HMDB -> KEGG 的 mapping table。
#   之後會跟 ChEBI -> KEGG、PubChem -> KEGG 的結果合併。

hmdb_to_kegg_raw <- read_csv(
  file.path(output_path, "14_HMDB_to_KEGG_MetaboAnalyst_raw.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# 先看 MetaboAnalyst 輸出的欄位名稱
names(hmdb_to_kegg_raw)

# 自動找 HMDB 欄位
hmdb_col <- names(hmdb_to_kegg_raw)[
  str_detect(names(hmdb_to_kegg_raw), regex("HMDB", ignore_case = TRUE))
][1]

# 自動找 KEGG 欄位
kegg_col <- names(hmdb_to_kegg_raw)[
  str_detect(names(hmdb_to_kegg_raw), regex("KEGG", ignore_case = TRUE))
][1]

hmdb_col
kegg_col
```

```{r}
#----33-1. clean direct HMDB-to-KEGG conversion result----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 先整理 MetaboAnalyst 直接給的 HMDB -> KEGG 結果。
# 2. 如果 HMDB 直接有 KEGG ID，就保留下來。
# 3. 如果 KEGG 是空的，先保留，下一步會用 ChEBI / PubChem rescue。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# hmdb_to_kegg_direct_15ppm_top10：
#   HMDB 直接對 KEGG 的結果。
#   這還不是最終版，因為還沒做 ChEBI/PubChem rescue。

hmdb_to_kegg_direct_15ppm_top10 <- hmdb_to_kegg_raw %>%
  transmute(
    HMDB_ID = as.character(.data[[hmdb_col]]),
    KEGG_ID = as.character(.data[[kegg_col]])
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_ID, sep = ";|,|\\s+") %>%
  mutate(
    HMDB_ID = str_squish(HMDB_ID),
    KEGG_ID = str_squish(KEGG_ID),
    HMDB_ID = na_if(HMDB_ID, ""),
    KEGG_ID = na_if(KEGG_ID, ""),
    KEGG_ID = str_replace(KEGG_ID, "^cpd:", "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HMDB_ID)) %>%
  distinct()

write_csv(
  hmdb_to_kegg_direct_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "14_HMDB_to_KEGG_direct_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

hmdb_to_kegg_direct_15ppm_top10 %>%
  summarise(
    Total_HMDB_rows = n(),
    Direct_HMDB_with_KEGG = sum(!is.na(KEGG_ID)),
    Direct_HMDB_without_KEGG = sum(is.na(KEGG_ID)),
    Direct_HMDB_to_KEGG_rate = Direct_HMDB_with_KEGG / Total_HMDB_rows
  )
```

```{r}
#----33-2. rescue HMDB entries without KEGG using MetaboAnalyst ChEBI/PubChem columns----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 有些 HMDB ID 在 MetaboAnalyst 中沒有直接對到 KEGG ID。
# 2. 但 MetaboAnalyst 可能提供了對應的 ChEBI 或 PubChem ID。
# 3. 這一步會把這些 ChEBI / PubChem ID 拿出來，再用 KEGG REST 嘗試轉成 KEGG ID。
# 4. 最後整理成 HMDB rescue mapping table。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# hmdb_rescue_query_15ppm_top10：
#   HMDB 沒有直接 KEGG，但有 ChEBI / PubChem 可以救援轉換的 query table。
# hmdb_rescue_to_kegg_15ppm_top10：
#   用 ChEBI / PubChem rescue 後得到的 HMDB -> KEGG mapping result。
#
# 注意：
# MetaboAnalyst 的 ChEBI / PubChem 欄位可能只有數字。
# KEGG REST 需要 chebi:xxxxx 或 pubchem:xxxxx。
# 所以這裡會強制補上 chebi: / pubchem: 前綴。

hmdb_rescue_source_15ppm_top10 <- hmdb_to_kegg_raw %>%
  transmute(
    HMDB_ID = as.character(HMDB),
    Direct_KEGG = as.character(KEGG),
    Rescue_ChEBI = as.character(ChEBI),
    Rescue_PubChem = as.character(PubChem)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    HMDB_ID = str_squish(HMDB_ID),
    Direct_KEGG = str_squish(Direct_KEGG),
    Rescue_ChEBI = str_squish(Rescue_ChEBI),
    Rescue_PubChem = str_squish(Rescue_PubChem),
    
    Direct_KEGG = na_if(Direct_KEGG, ""),
    Direct_KEGG = na_if(Direct_KEGG, "NA"),
    Direct_KEGG = na_if(Direct_KEGG, "-"),
    
    Rescue_ChEBI = na_if(Rescue_ChEBI, ""),
    Rescue_ChEBI = na_if(Rescue_ChEBI, "NA"),
    Rescue_ChEBI = na_if(Rescue_ChEBI, "-"),
    
    Rescue_PubChem = na_if(Rescue_PubChem, ""),
    Rescue_PubChem = na_if(Rescue_PubChem, "NA"),
    Rescue_PubChem = na_if(Rescue_PubChem, "-")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(HMDB_ID),
    is.na(Direct_KEGG),
    !is.na(Rescue_ChEBI) | !is.na(Rescue_PubChem)
  )

hmdb_rescue_chebi_query <- hmdb_rescue_source_15ppm_top10 %>%
  select(HMDB_ID, Rescue_ChEBI) %>%
  separate_rows(Rescue_ChEBI, sep = ";|,|\\s+") %>%
  mutate(
    Rescue_ChEBI = str_squish(Rescue_ChEBI),
    Rescue_ChEBI = na_if(Rescue_ChEBI, ""),
    Rescue_ChEBI = na_if(Rescue_ChEBI, "NA"),
    Rescue_ChEBI = na_if(Rescue_ChEBI, "-"),
    
    Rescue_ChEBI_number = str_extract(Rescue_ChEBI, "\\d+"),
    
    Rescue_query = if_else(
      !is.na(Rescue_ChEBI_number),
      paste0("chebi:", Rescue_ChEBI_number),
      NA_character_
    ),
    
    Rescue_source = "HMDB_rescue_ChEBI"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rescue_query)) %>%
  select(
    HMDB_ID,
    Rescue_source,
    Rescue_ID = Rescue_ChEBI,
    Rescue_query
  )

hmdb_rescue_pubchem_query <- hmdb_rescue_source_15ppm_top10 %>%
  select(HMDB_ID, Rescue_PubChem) %>%
  separate_rows(Rescue_PubChem, sep = ";|,|\\s+") %>%
  mutate(
    Rescue_PubChem = str_squish(Rescue_PubChem),
    Rescue_PubChem = na_if(Rescue_PubChem, ""),
    Rescue_PubChem = na_if(Rescue_PubChem, "NA"),
    Rescue_PubChem = na_if(Rescue_PubChem, "-"),
    
    Rescue_PubChem_number = str_extract(Rescue_PubChem, "\\d+"),
    
    Rescue_query = if_else(
      !is.na(Rescue_PubChem_number),
      paste0("pubchem:", Rescue_PubChem_number),
      NA_character_
    ),
    
    Rescue_source = "HMDB_rescue_PubChem"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rescue_query)) %>%
  select(
    HMDB_ID,
    Rescue_source,
    Rescue_ID = Rescue_PubChem,
    Rescue_query
  )

hmdb_rescue_query_15ppm_top10 <- bind_rows(
  hmdb_rescue_chebi_query,
  hmdb_rescue_pubchem_query
) %>%
  distinct()

write_csv(
  hmdb_rescue_query_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "14_HMDB_rescue_ChEBI_PubChem_query_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

hmdb_rescue_kegg_raw_15ppm_top10 <- convert_kegg_id(
  query_vec = hmdb_rescue_query_15ppm_top10$Rescue_query,
  query_col_name = "Rescue_query",
  sleep_sec = 0.4
)

hmdb_rescue_to_kegg_15ppm_top10 <- hmdb_rescue_query_15ppm_top10 %>%
  left_join(
    hmdb_rescue_kegg_raw_15ppm_top10,
    by = "Rescue_query",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  distinct()

write_csv(
  hmdb_rescue_to_kegg_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "14_HMDB_rescue_to_KEGG_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

hmdb_rescue_summary_15ppm_top10 <- hmdb_rescue_to_kegg_15ppm_top10 %>%
  summarise(
    Rescue_query_rows = n(),
    Rescue_rows_with_KEGG = sum(!is.na(KEGG_ID)),
    Rescue_rows_without_KEGG = sum(is.na(KEGG_ID)),
    Rescue_unique_HMDB_with_KEGG = n_distinct(HMDB_ID[!is.na(KEGG_ID)]),
    Rescue_unique_KEGG_IDs = n_distinct(KEGG_ID, na.rm = TRUE),
    Rescue_KEGG_hit_rate = Rescue_rows_with_KEGG / Rescue_query_rows
  )

write_csv(
  hmdb_rescue_summary_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "14_HMDB_rescue_to_KEGG_Summary_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

hmdb_rescue_summary_15ppm_top10
```

```{r}
#----33-3. combine direct HMDB-to-KEGG and rescue HMDB-to-KEGG mapping----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 合併兩種 HMDB -> KEGG 結果：
#    A. MetaboAnalyst 直接給的 HMDB -> KEGG
#    B. HMDB 沒有直接 KEGG，但用 ChEBI / PubChem rescue 出來的 KEGG
# 2. 只保留成功對到 KEGG_ID 的 rows。
# 3. KEGG_ID 是 NA 的 rows 直接刪掉，不進入下一層分析。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# hmdb_to_kegg_15ppm_top10：
#   最終版 HMDB -> KEGG mapping table。
#   這張表只包含成功對到 KEGG ID 的 HMDB。
#
# 注意：
# 後面的 #34 會用這張表，不再使用 direct-only 或 rescue raw table。

hmdb_direct_success_15ppm_top10 <- hmdb_to_kegg_direct_15ppm_top10 %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID)) %>%
  mutate(
    HMDB_KEGG_source = "HMDB_direct"
  )

hmdb_rescue_success_15ppm_top10 <- hmdb_rescue_to_kegg_15ppm_top10 %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID)) %>%
  transmute(
    HMDB_ID,
    KEGG_ID,
    HMDB_KEGG_source = Rescue_source
  )

hmdb_to_kegg_15ppm_top10 <- bind_rows(
  hmdb_direct_success_15ppm_top10,
  hmdb_rescue_success_15ppm_top10
) %>%
  mutate(
    HMDB_ID = as.character(HMDB_ID),
    KEGG_ID = as.character(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID = str_replace(KEGG_ID, "^cpd:", ""),
    KEGG_ID = str_squish(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID = na_if(KEGG_ID, "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HMDB_ID), !is.na(KEGG_ID)) %>%
  distinct()

write_csv(
  hmdb_to_kegg_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "14_HMDB_to_KEGG_direct_plus_rescue_mapped_only_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

hmdb_to_kegg_summary_15ppm_top10 <- hmdb_to_kegg_15ppm_top10 %>%
  summarise(
    HMDB_with_KEGG = n_distinct(HMDB_ID),
    Unique_KEGG_IDs = n_distinct(KEGG_ID),
    Mapping_rows = n()
  )

write_csv(
  hmdb_to_kegg_summary_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "14_HMDB_to_KEGG_direct_plus_rescue_Summary_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

hmdb_to_kegg_summary_15ppm_top10
```

```{r}
#----34. merge ChEBI-, PubChem-, and HMDB-derived KEGG IDs back to external ID long table----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 把三條 mapping 接回 external_ID_long_15ppm_top10ID：
#    ChEBI   -> KEGG
#    PubChem -> KEGG
#    HMDB direct/rescue -> KEGG
# 2. 只保留成功對到 KEGG_ID 的 rows。
# 3. KEGG_ID 是 NA 的 rows 直接刪掉。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# external_ID_to_KEGG_15ppm_top10：
#   ID-level KEGG bridge table。
#   每一列代表某個 external ID 成功對到一個 KEGG_ID。
#
# 注意：
# 這張表已經沒有 KEGG_ID = NA 的 rows。
# 所以下一層資料不會再包含「對不到 KEGG 的 metabolite」。

chebi_kegg_bridge_15ppm_top10 <- external_ID_long_15ppm_top10ID %>%
  filter(ID_type == "ChEBI_ID") %>%
  left_join(
    chebi_to_kegg_15ppm_top10,
    by = c("KEGG_query" = "ChEBI_query"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_source = "ChEBI",
    HMDB_KEGG_source = NA_character_
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID))

pubchem_kegg_bridge_15ppm_top10 <- external_ID_long_15ppm_top10ID %>%
  filter(ID_type == "PubChem_ID") %>%
  left_join(
    pubchem_to_kegg_15ppm_top10,
    by = c("KEGG_query" = "PubChem_query"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_source = "PubChem",
    HMDB_KEGG_source = NA_character_
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID))

hmdb_kegg_bridge_15ppm_top10 <- external_ID_long_15ppm_top10ID %>%
  filter(ID_type == "HMDB_ID") %>%
  left_join(
    hmdb_to_kegg_15ppm_top10,
    by = c("External_ID" = "HMDB_ID"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_source = "HMDB"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID))

external_ID_to_KEGG_15ppm_top10 <- bind_rows(
  chebi_kegg_bridge_15ppm_top10,
  pubchem_kegg_bridge_15ppm_top10,
  hmdb_kegg_bridge_15ppm_top10
) %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_ID = as.character(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID = str_replace(KEGG_ID, "^cpd:", ""),
    KEGG_ID = str_squish(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID = na_if(KEGG_ID, "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID)) %>%
  select(
    Mode,
    Compound,
    `Compound ID`,
    CSID,
    ID_type,
    External_ID,
    KEGG_query,
    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_source,
    HMDB_KEGG_source,
    Score,
    `Fragmentation Score`,
    `Mass Error (ppm)`,
    Abs_Mass_Error_ppm,
    `Isotope Similarity`,
    Candidate_rank_within_Compound,
    External_ID_rank_within_Compound,
    Total_candidates_within_Compound,
    Total_external_ID_within_Compound
  ) %>%
  distinct()

write_csv(
  external_ID_to_KEGG_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "15_External_ID_to_KEGG_bridge_mapped_only_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

external_ID_to_KEGG_summary_15ppm_top10 <- external_ID_to_KEGG_15ppm_top10 %>%
  group_by(Mode, KEGG_source) %>%
  summarise(
    Rows_with_KEGG = n(),
    Unique_KEGG_IDs = n_distinct(KEGG_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  external_ID_to_KEGG_summary_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "15_External_ID_to_KEGG_bridge_Summary_mapped_only_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

external_ID_to_KEGG_summary_15ppm_top10
```

```{r}
#----35. create Compound-level KEGG annotation table from mapped KEGG rows only----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. external_ID_to_KEGG_15ppm_top10 是 ID-level table。
#    一個 Compound 可能有多列，因為它可能透過多個 ChEBI / HMDB / PubChem 對到 KEGG。
# 2. 這一步把 ID-level table collapse 回 Compound-level。
# 3. 因為 #34 已經刪掉 KEGG_ID = NA，所以這一步只會保留有 KEGG_ID 的 features。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# compound_KEGG_annotation_15ppm_top10：
#   Compound-level KEGG annotation table。
#   每個 Compound 一列，且一定至少有一個 KEGG_ID。
#
# 注意：
# KEGG_mapping_status：
#   Single_KEGG   = 這個 feature 只有一個 KEGG ID，較好解讀
#   Multiple_KEGG = 這個 feature 對到多個 KEGG ID，有 annotation ambiguity
#
# 這裡不會再有 No_KEGG，因為 No_KEGG 已經被刪掉。

collapse_unique_ids <- function(x) {
  
  x <- x %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    as.character() %>%
    paste(collapse = ";") %>%
    str_split(";") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    str_squish()
  
  x <- x[x != ""]
  x <- unique(x)
  
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    paste(x, collapse = ";")
  }
}

count_semicolon_ids <- function(x) {
  
  ifelse(
    is.na(x) | x == "",
    0,
    str_count(x, ";") + 1
  )
}

compound_KEGG_annotation_15ppm_top10 <- external_ID_to_KEGG_15ppm_top10 %>%
  group_by(Mode, Compound) %>%
  summarise(
    KEGG_ID = collapse_unique_ids(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_source = collapse_unique_ids(KEGG_source),
    HMDB_KEGG_source = collapse_unique_ids(HMDB_KEGG_source),
    ChEBI_ID = collapse_unique_ids(ifelse(ID_type == "ChEBI_ID", External_ID, NA_character_)),
    Final_HMDB_ID = collapse_unique_ids(ifelse(ID_type == "HMDB_ID", External_ID, NA_character_)),
    PubChem_ID = collapse_unique_ids(ifelse(ID_type == "PubChem_ID", External_ID, NA_character_)),
    CSID = collapse_unique_ids(CSID),
    `Compound ID` = collapse_unique_ids(`Compound ID`),
    Best_abs_mass_error_ppm = min(Abs_Mass_Error_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
    Best_score = max(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Best_fragmentation_score = max(`Fragmentation Score`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_total_candidates_before_top10 = max(Total_candidates_within_Compound, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_KEGG_ID = count_semicolon_ids(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_mapping_status = case_when(
      n_KEGG_ID == 1 ~ "Single_KEGG",
      n_KEGG_ID > 1 ~ "Multiple_KEGG"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID))

write_csv(
  compound_KEGG_annotation_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "16_Compound_KEGG_annotation_mapped_only_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

compound_KEGG_annotation_summary_15ppm_top10 <- compound_KEGG_annotation_15ppm_top10 %>%
  group_by(Mode, KEGG_mapping_status) %>%
  summarise(
    Features = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Mode) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_KEGG_mapped_features = sum(Features),
    Feature_rate = Features / Total_KEGG_mapped_features
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(
  compound_KEGG_annotation_summary_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "16_Compound_KEGG_annotation_Summary_mapped_only_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

compound_KEGG_annotation_summary_15ppm_top10
```

```{r}
#----36. merge KEGG-mapped annotation back to measurement tables----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 把有 KEGG_ID 的 Compound-level annotation 對回 measurement table。
# 2. 沒有 KEGG_ID 的 metabolites 不進入主分析。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# NEG_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10：
#   NEG mode 中，有 intensity 且有 KEGG_ID 的主分析資料。
# POS_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10：
#   POS mode 中，有 intensity 且有 KEGG_ID 的主分析資料。
#
# 注意：
# 這兩張表是後面 PCA、fold-change、individual metabolite、KEGG pathway input 的主分析資料。
# 這裡已經不包含 KEGG_ID = NA 的 features。

NEG_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10 <- NEG_measure_rm %>%
  left_join(
    compound_KEGG_annotation_15ppm_top10 %>%
      filter(Mode == "NEG") %>%
      select(-Mode),
    by = "Compound"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID))

POS_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10 <- POS_measure_rm %>%
  left_join(
    compound_KEGG_annotation_15ppm_top10 %>%
      filter(Mode == "POS") %>%
      select(-Mode),
    by = "Compound"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID))

write_csv(
  NEG_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "17_NEG_measurement_with_KEGG_mapped_only_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

write_csv(
  POS_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "17_POS_measurement_with_KEGG_mapped_only_15ppm_top10.csv")
)
```

```{r}
#----37. summarize final KEGG-mapped measurement features----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 檢查最後進入主分析的 KEGG-mapped measurement features 有多少。
# 2. 區分 Single_KEGG 和 Multiple_KEGG。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# final_KEGG_mapping_summary_15ppm_top10：
#   最終主分析中，POS / NEG 有多少 features 有 KEGG_ID。
#
# 注意：
# 因為前面已經刪掉 KEGG_ID = NA，
# 所以這裡不會有 No_KEGG。

final_KEGG_mapping_summary_15ppm_top10 <- bind_rows(
  NEG_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10 %>% mutate(Mode = "NEG"),
  POS_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10 %>% mutate(Mode = "POS")
) %>%
  group_by(Mode, KEGG_mapping_status) %>%
  summarise(
    Features = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Mode) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_KEGG_mapped_features = sum(Features),
    Feature_rate = Features / Total_KEGG_mapped_features
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(
  final_KEGG_mapping_summary_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "17_Final_KEGG_mapping_Summary_mapped_only_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

final_KEGG_mapping_summary_15ppm_top10
```

```{r}
#----38. export unique KEGG IDs for pathway analysis----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 從最後的 measurement table 中抽出 unique KEGG_ID。
# 2. 如果一個 feature 有多個 KEGG_ID，這裡會拆開成多列。
# 3. 這份表可以拿去做 KEGG pathway / enrichment analysis。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# unique_KEGG_IDs_for_pathway_15ppm_top10：
#   最後可以拿去做 KEGG pathway analysis 的 KEGG compound ID list。

unique_KEGG_IDs_for_pathway_15ppm_top10 <- bind_rows(
  NEG_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10 %>% mutate(Mode = "NEG"),
  POS_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10 %>% mutate(Mode = "POS")
) %>%
  select(Mode, Compound, KEGG_ID) %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_ID, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_ID = str_squish(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID = na_if(KEGG_ID, "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID)) %>%
  distinct(Mode, Compound, KEGG_ID)

write_csv(
  unique_KEGG_IDs_for_pathway_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "18_Unique_KEGG_IDs_for_pathway_mapped_only_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

unique_KEGG_IDs_for_pathway_summary_15ppm_top10 <- unique_KEGG_IDs_for_pathway_15ppm_top10 %>%
  group_by(Mode) %>%
  summarise(
    Features_with_KEGG = n_distinct(Compound),
    Unique_KEGG_IDs = n_distinct(KEGG_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  unique_KEGG_IDs_for_pathway_summary_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "18_Unique_KEGG_IDs_for_pathway_Summary_mapped_only_15ppm_top10.csv")
)
```

```{r}
#----38. export KEGG IDs for pathway analysis with ambiguity control----
# 這一步在做什麼？
# 1. 從最後的 KEGG-mapped measurement table 中輸出 KEGG pathway input。
# 2. 但不直接把所有 Multiple_KEGG 拆開當成獨立代謝物。
# 3. 產生三個版本：
#    A. Single_KEGG only：最保守，建議作為正式主分析。
#    B. Best_KEGG per feature：每個 feature 只保留一個 KEGG，作探索分析。
#    C. All KEGG expanded：全部展開，只作 QC，不建議直接做正式 enrichment。
#
# 這一步得到的 Data 代表什麼？
# single_KEGG_for_pathway_15ppm_top10：
#   只包含 Single_KEGG features，最乾淨。
# best_KEGG_per_feature_for_pathway_15ppm_top10：
#   Single + Multiple features，但每個 feature 只選一個 KEGG ID。
# all_KEGG_expanded_QC_15ppm_top10：
#   所有 KEGG ID 展開版，只用來看 ambiguity，不作正式主分析。

measure_with_KEGG_all_15ppm_top10 <- bind_rows(
  NEG_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10 %>% mutate(Mode = "NEG"),
  POS_measure_with_KEGG_15ppm_top10 %>% mutate(Mode = "POS")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature_ID = paste(Mode, Compound, sep = "_")
  )

#----38A. Conservative pathway input: Single_KEGG only----
# 這份是最保守的 KEGG pathway input。
# 每個 feature 只對到一個 KEGG ID，所以不會有一個訊號被複製成多個 KEGG 的問題。

single_KEGG_for_pathway_15ppm_top10 <- measure_with_KEGG_all_15ppm_top10 %>%
  filter(KEGG_mapping_status == "Single_KEGG") %>%
  select(
    Mode,
    Feature_ID,
    Compound,
    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_source,
    KEGG_mapping_status,
    Best_abs_mass_error_ppm,
    Best_score,
    Best_fragmentation_score
  ) %>%
  distinct()

write_csv(
  single_KEGG_for_pathway_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "18A_Single_KEGG_only_for_pathway_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

single_KEGG_for_pathway_summary_15ppm_top10 <- single_KEGG_for_pathway_15ppm_top10 %>%
  group_by(Mode) %>%
  summarise(
    Single_KEGG_features = n_distinct(Feature_ID),
    Unique_KEGG_IDs = n_distinct(KEGG_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  single_KEGG_for_pathway_summary_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "18A_Single_KEGG_only_for_pathway_Summary_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

single_KEGG_for_pathway_summary_15ppm_top10


#----38B. Exploratory pathway input: choose one best KEGG per feature----
# 這份是探索版。
# 對 Multiple_KEGG features，每個 feature 只選一個 KEGG ID。
# 選擇邏輯：
# 1. 優先 KEGG_source = ChEBI
# 2. 再來 HMDB
# 3. 最後 PubChem
# 4. 若仍有多個，保留排序第一個
#
# 風險：
# best KEGG 不一定是真的身分，只是為了避免一個 feature 被重複計數。

best_KEGG_per_feature_for_pathway_15ppm_top10 <- external_ID_to_KEGG_15ppm_top10 %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID)) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature_ID = paste(Mode, Compound, sep = "_"),
    KEGG_source_priority = case_when(
      KEGG_source == "ChEBI" ~ 1,
      KEGG_source == "HMDB" ~ 2,
      KEGG_source == "PubChem" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 9
    ),
    Score_for_rank = replace_na(Score, -Inf),
    Fragmentation_for_rank = replace_na(`Fragmentation Score`, -Inf),
    Isotope_for_rank = replace_na(`Isotope Similarity`, -Inf)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Mode, Feature_ID, Compound) %>%
  arrange(
    KEGG_source_priority,
    Abs_Mass_Error_ppm,
    desc(Fragmentation_for_rank),
    desc(Score_for_rank),
    desc(Isotope_for_rank),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    Mode,
    Feature_ID,
    Compound,
    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_source,
    ID_type,
    External_ID,
    Best_abs_mass_error_ppm = Abs_Mass_Error_ppm,
    Score,
    `Fragmentation Score`,
    `Isotope Similarity`
  ) %>%
  distinct()

write_csv(
  best_KEGG_per_feature_for_pathway_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "18B_Best_KEGG_per_feature_for_pathway_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

best_KEGG_per_feature_summary_15ppm_top10 <- best_KEGG_per_feature_for_pathway_15ppm_top10 %>%
  group_by(Mode) %>%
  summarise(
    Features_with_best_KEGG = n_distinct(Feature_ID),
    Unique_KEGG_IDs = n_distinct(KEGG_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  best_KEGG_per_feature_summary_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "18B_Best_KEGG_per_feature_for_pathway_Summary_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

best_KEGG_per_feature_summary_15ppm_top10


#----38C. QC only: all KEGG IDs expanded----
# 這份會把 Multiple_KEGG 全部拆開。
# 不建議直接拿去作正式 enrichment。
# 用途：
# 1. 看有多少 ambiguity
# 2. 檢查哪些 features 對到太多 KEGG
# 3. 作為補充資料

all_KEGG_expanded_QC_15ppm_top10 <- measure_with_KEGG_all_15ppm_top10 %>%
  select(
    Mode,
    Feature_ID,
    Compound,
    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_mapping_status,
    KEGG_source,
    Best_abs_mass_error_ppm,
    Best_score,
    Best_fragmentation_score
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_ID, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_ID = str_squish(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID = na_if(KEGG_ID, "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID)) %>%
  distinct()

write_csv(
  all_KEGG_expanded_QC_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "18C_All_KEGG_expanded_QC_only_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

all_KEGG_expanded_QC_summary_15ppm_top10 <- all_KEGG_expanded_QC_15ppm_top10 %>%
  group_by(Mode) %>%
  summarise(
    Features_with_KEGG = n_distinct(Feature_ID),
    Expanded_KEGG_rows = n(),
    Unique_KEGG_IDs = n_distinct(KEGG_ID),
    Mean_KEGG_per_feature = Expanded_KEGG_rows / Features_with_KEGG,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  all_KEGG_expanded_QC_summary_15ppm_top10,
  file.path(output_path, "18C_All_KEGG_expanded_QC_only_Summary_15ppm_top10.csv")
)

all_KEGG_expanded_QC_summary_15ppm_top10
```
